title: TableArenaHeadroomFixture
description: Cases for the stdio structural table (csv/tsv editors) under a short process-wide UiValue arena: a rows x width editable table, the store revision its cells bind, and the headroom left free while it renders (the structure controls' own collections plus a share of what the complete body holds). The body renders whole or shortened, never refused; the structure controls always render.

revision.description: The canonical store revision every cell and structure control binds.

editableHeaders.description: Header cells are editable (csv) or read-only (tsv).

headroom.description: Arena collections left free beyond the structure controls' own: none (controls), a third, half, or all of the complete body's.
